02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in T.R Case No.343 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Bhubaneswar, arising out of Info City P.S. Case No.221 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 376/376(2)(n)/294/506 IPC and Section 6/4 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text:
Addl.
Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Ad hoc Addl. Sessions Judge (FTSC), Bhubaneswar by order dated 05.12.2023 in the aforementioned case,
the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. This is the second journey of the Petitioner to this Court.
Earlier the bail application of the Petitioner was rejected by order dated 22.03.2023 in BLAPL No.12975 of 2022 giving liberty to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of the victim.
Since the victim has already examined, the Petitioner seeks release relying on the statement of the victim and the medical examination report.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
6. This Court perused the statement of the victim as well as her mother examined as P.Ws.1 and 2.
